storyTitle: Tuval's Story – A Hero Never Forgotten
storyH3: The boy who became a warrior
storyP1: Tuval Yaakov Tzanani was born in Kiryat Gat on November 20, 2003. From a young age, he stood out with his special personality – a boy with an infectious smile, a big heart, and a constant willingness to help others.
storyP2: In school, Tuval was beloved by his friends and teachers. He believed that "in the end, everything will be okay" – a phrase that became his life motto and accompanied him every step of the way.
storyP3: When it came time to enlist, Tuval had no doubt – he wanted to be a fighter, to protect the country and the people he loved. He chose the Armored Corps, where he became an outstanding gunner in a Merkava tank.
storyQuote: "Tuval taught us that true heroism is not only on the battlefield, but in the ability to live even in the hardest moments and believe that in the end, everything will be okay"

battleTitle: The Last Battle – Heroism in Swords of Iron
battleP1: On December 4, 2023, during the Swords of Iron war, Tuval went out with his tank crew on a combat mission in the Gaza Strip. They knew the mission was dangerous, but they were determined to defend the State of Israel.
battleP2: In the fierce battle, Tuval's tank was hit. Along with him fell his two close friends – Eitan Fish and Yakir Yedidia Shinkolvsky z"l. Three young men full of life, dreams, and hopes, who gave their lives for their homeland.
battleP3: Tuval was 20 years old when he fell. A young man who lived life full of love, joy, and meaning, leaving behind a legacy of heroism and hope that will live forever.

testimonialsTitle: What People Say About the Lectures

testimonials.text: Highly recommended, a fascinating lecture that gives strength and values every time. Ravid manages to convey his brother's story in a way that touches every soldier. The lecture leaves them with motivation and strength to continue their important mission.
testimonials.name: Barak Family, Battalion 53, Golan Company

testimonials.text: A warm recommendation – an inspiring lecture that touches the heart and leaves a deep impression. Ravid brings his personal story honestly and openly, making everyone think about their life, what truly matters, and the power each of us has to make a difference.
testimonials.name: Heroism Forum

testimonials.text: A powerful lecture that brings the heroism story of the armored fighters in a real and moving way. Ravid manages to connect everyone to values of brotherhood, dedication, and love of the land. A must for every soldier and every Israeli.
testimonials.name: Israeli Armored Corps

whyReasons: Because in a world that rushes forward, sometimes you need to stop and remember what truly matters.
Because Tuval's story is the story of all of us – about love, courage, and the ability to believe.
Because each of us needs to hear that even in the hardest moments, in the end, everything will be okay.
